note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Turn unclear Actions into clear next steps
purpose: Arcadia checks each under-specified Action and either writes a concrete next step or asks the operator exactly one question about what is missing. The original input is kept either way.
serves: The Project outcome of Arcadia asking for a decision only when one is genuinely needed.
done_when: An unclear Action ends with either a concrete next step or one question for the operator, and the original input is still there.
reading_note: Inference: the Plan is marked complete, but check its last Action, which requires clarified Actions before planning work and waits for a Decision.

actions.title: Add basic commands for artifacts and expected outputs
actions.why: Gives the clarification work a place to record what each Action should produce.
actions.done_when: The help lists the artifact command and the expected-artifact option, and an artifact created for an Action keeps the value given.

actions.title: Add clarification fields to work items
actions.why: Stores whether an Action is clear, what is missing, and where that judgement came from.
actions.done_when: New and upgraded databases both have the clarification fields, with no duplicates after repeated upgrades.

actions.title: Record clarification questions as decisions and subtasks
actions.why: Lets a missing piece of information become a question the operator answers, and lets a large Action be split.
actions.done_when: A clarification question opens as a decision, and a subtask shows its parent Action in the list.

actions.title: Clarify Actions with the Arcadia assistant
actions.why: Lets the system judge each Action automatically and ask one question when something is missing.
actions.done_when: A clear Action is marked clarified, and an unclear one is marked open with one question and its gap type, with the original input preserved.

actions.title: Require clarified Actions before planning work
actions.why: Stops unclear Actions from being dispatched until the operator decides how the rule applies.
actions.done_when: A decision records whether planning requires clarified Actions, and until it is answered an unclear Action is not dispatched.
